Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Conversely, those who out of envy disregard these universal teachings and refuse to practice them remain bereft of true knowledge. Such individuals become confused and stay trapped in ignorance and self-created bondage.
Situation/Problem_Faced: The psychological and spiritual consequences of ignoring sound guidance due to ego, envy, or arrogance.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna warns that rejecting beneficial wisdom out of envy leads to intellectual blindness (sarva-jnana-vimudhan) and ultimate ruination.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna sees the stark contrast between open-minded adherence to duty and ego-driven rejection.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cognitive Resistance: Rejecting valuable advice or truth due to personal bias and pride
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Consequences of Egoism: Allowing arrogance to obscure sound judgment
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Self-Defeating Resistance: Refusing to adopt healthy practices out of resentment, resulting in self-harm

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Abhyasuyanto (Disregarding higher wisdom out of envy or spite)
Sarva-jnana-vimudhan (Completely deluded and bereft of true discrimination)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Those who foolishly reject divine wisdom out of envy and pride remain spiritually blind. Ignoring the fundamental laws of righteous action keeps one bound in cycles of confusion and suffering.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Rejecting proven wisdom or self-improvement strategies simply out of ego or spite is self-defeating. Resisting healthy boundaries isolates the mind in ignorance and prolongs avoidable stress.
